sections.text:
BioIntel Demo
Immunology reference page
BioIntel demonstration record 10. The compound upadacitinib was discussed with target JAK1 in the context of atopic dermatitis. The example mutation is V658F. A demonstration IC50 measurement of 755 nM is shown for Homo sapiens. Synthetic reference labels: SYN-PAPER-0010 and SYN-DOI-NOT-REAL-0010.
